task.text: One Breath MVP Chapter 0: an interactive Go teaching act carried by one life case (同气/The Shared Corridor), then the same position read as the case (照见), then 觉悟人生 (four views) ending in a concrete response (行); bilingual, deterministic, no scoring, no AI

modules.rule_en: Truth and traceability outrank speed; automate only observe/record/rank
Context is a finite, scarce resource - curate, don't dump
reasons: always: context is consumed by every step (M0.6)

modules.rule_en: Externalize memory; advance incrementally; make every run resumable
reasons: capability: resumable-memory, context-budget-policy, durable-execution, loop-discipline, graph-orchestration

modules.rule_en: Define done before work; verify the verifier; hard vs soft gates
reasons: capability: verification-gate, frontier-standard, ambition-elevation, expert-instruments, durable-execution, cost-budget-caps, eval-driven-development, loop-discipline, formal-verification, evidence-bounded-generation, component-ablation

modules.rule_en: Every fact traceable to a primary source; uncertain means uncertain
reasons: capability: traceable-sources, expert-instruments, untrusted-content-discipline, formal-verification, evidence-bounded-generation
capability: self-improving-loop, frontier-standard, bidirectional-capability-flow, eval-driven-development, gap-seeking, component-ablation

modules.rule_en: Minimal toolset; biased errors; skills load progressively
reasons: capability: tool-use, portable-skills, expert-instruments, untrusted-content-discipline, loop-discipline, formal-verification

modules.rule_en: Single source of truth; reviewable diffs; no unsolicited destructive acts

params.commit_policy: conventional commits; commit ok; never auto-push

reasons: always: single source of truth + reviewable diffs (M0.5/M0.9)

modules.rule_en: Explicit contracts; escalate decisions; hand off with state
